plain_text:
Virginia Gregg appears in 761 recordings across 37 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1942 to 1979. The credits here include performer, commercial spokesman, and commercial spokeswoman.

In this archive, you will hear Virginia Gregg most often in Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Have Gun, Will Travel, Richard Diamond, Private Detective, Let George Do It, Dr. Kildare, The Line Up, Gunsmoke, and Dragnet.

Characters credited here include Helen Asher, Claire Brooks, Miss Wong, and Nurse Parker.
